title: Continuous Trend Delta Foundation
goal: Turn scheduled validation history into useful trend, drift, and delta review without adding a second scheduler.
scope: Build the first trend and delta view on top of existing scheduled runs, run history, findings, inventory, and reports. Keep scheduling execution on the existing approval-aware task pipeline.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found trend and drift output was missing after scheduled-run foundation.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add trend/delta review only. Do not add arbitrary cron editing, background recurring workers, or portfolio billing features.
notes: Trend claims must be backed by comparable runs.
Missing or incomparable baselines must be stated honestly.

success_criteria: Operators can compare scheduled validation runs for finding, inventory, or report deltas.
Trend summaries distinguish new, resolved, persistent, and changed findings where evidence supports it.
Unsupported or incomparable comparisons show truthful fallback copy.
API and/or browser tests cover comparable and non-comparable histories.
The existing scheduler and dispatch pipeline remain unchanged unless narrowly required.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Trend and delta output is based on comparable stored runs.
Fallbacks are explicit when comparison is not valid.
No second scheduler or runtime lane is introduced.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Existing scheduled-run lineage fields are inspected.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with trend/delta changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the continuous trend baseline and remaining continuous-mode limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
